summary: Outvin multi-make Factory Options integration verified end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases green — VW FB-000155 outvin_spec persisted (make=Volkswagen, model='Tiguan 1.4actCLBMTFR 110TSID6F', 190/190 options with description, production_date 2018-03-05); BMW FB-000116 newly ordered (make=BMW, model='X4 M40i', series='X4', generation='G02', engine_code='B58D', power_kw=285, 71/71 options) — coexists with existing bimmer_spec; Mercedes FB-000156 newly ordered (make='Mercedes-Benz', model='Mercedes-AMG C 43 4MATIC Sedan', 148/148 named options) — coexists with existing mb_spec; Chery FB-000128 rejected with 400 as non-supported make; duplicate VW re-order returns 409; quota log line 'outvin: decoded VIN=... make=... options=n/n (14 requests remaining)' verified in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log for all three VINs (Outvin apparently doesn't decrement the counter on cached-VIN repeats — still shows 14 remaining after 3 lookups). Frontend (Expo mobile, 390x844, dealer dave@fourbuy.co.za): FB-000155 shows a dynamic row labelled 'Volkswagen Factory Options' with R20, a DELIVERED pill, and a VIEW button. Tapping VIEW opens a modal with the rich caption '190 factory-fitted options · VIN WVGZZZ5NZJW402485 · Volkswagen · Tiguan 1.4actCLBMTFR 110TSID6F · Built 2018-03-05 · CZEA 4-cylinder SI engine 1.4 l TSI, 110 kW · 1.40L · 110kW · Petrol · Colour Pure White... · Interior Titanium Black...' followed by ~190 OPT option pills (verified pe0a Warning triangle, pk8g Hatchback, etc.). BMW FB-000116 shows TWO rows both labelled 'BMW Factory Options' (bmw_options + outvin_spec) — UX collision confirmed but functionally both are orderable/viewable. Mercedes FB-000156 shows 'Mercedes Factory Options' (mb_options catalog name) AND 'Mercedes-Benz Factory Options' (outvin dynamic label) — different labels so no collision. Chery FB-000128 correctly hides the outvin_spec row. Light theme toggle still renders the Volkswagen row correctly. Password for dealer dave@fourbuy.co.za was reset via admin API during the run (previous value invalidated by rebuild).

minor.issue: dave@fourbuy.co.za password (per test_credentials.md) was invalid on the current preview DB — reset to Dave1234! via admin API to unblock testing. Same as iteration_56; consider seeding on startup.

Outvin API returned 'available_requests=14' for all 3 successful lookups (VW+BMW+Merc) — either Outvin does not bill cached-VIN repeats or the counter refreshes on a schedule. Not a bug in our code; just note that the log-based quota alerting will not fire unless a genuine new VIN burns a credit.

ui_bugs.issue: Two rows on BMW submissions are both labelled 'BMW Factory Options' (one from static bmw_options catalog, one from the dynamic outvin_spec label). Both priced at R20 so no discriminator visible to the dealer. Not a functional bug — both are orderable and viewable — but a UX ambiguity that was flagged in the PR itself. Suggest suffixing the outvin_spec row with e.g. '(Outvin)' when the make already has a native provider, or renaming Bimmervin's static label to 'BMW Factory Options (SA codes)' vs Outvin's 'BMW Factory Options (Datacard)'.

The modal title/header still reads the generic 'Factory Options' catalog name (e.g. on VW it says 'Factory Options', not 'Volkswagen Factory Options'). The dynamic '<Make> Factory Options' label is only applied to the row and to the confirm-order sheet, not to the delivered-report modal header. Minor cosmetic inconsistency.

issues: Regression unrelated to Outvin: 'Market Values' card shows 'Could not fetch market values. Kredo has no model matching TIGUAN / TAYRON for VOLKSWAGEN.' — Kredo model lookup fails for the Tiguan; suggest investigating Kredo model mapping. Does not affect outvin_spec rendering.

action_items: (P2 UX) Disambiguate the two BMW rows on BMW submissions — both say 'BMW Factory Options' and both cost R20. Either suffix the outvin_spec label with '(Datacard)' or the bmw_options static catalog name with '(SA codes)' so dealers know they're distinct products.

(P3) Also apply the '<Make> Factory Options' dynamic label to the ReportResultBody modal header (currently only the row and confirm-sheet use the dynamic label; the delivered-report modal header still shows the generic 'Factory Options').
(Unrelated regression) Kredo model lookup fails for FB-000155 VW Tiguan — 'no model matching TIGUAN / TAYRON for VOLKSWAGEN'. Suggest a separate ticket for Kredo model mapping.
(Housekeeping) Persist dave@fourbuy.co.za password across preview rebuilds — third iteration in a row that has been reset.

(Optional) Consider a client-side check to warn the dealer that Outvin has NOT decremented available_requests despite multiple lookups (may indicate their metering is cached — worth confirming with the vendor).
critical_code_review_comments: REPORT_CATALOG['outvin_spec']['name'] = 'Factory Options' is intentionally generic — the dynamic label is applied client-side only. This means any surface that pulls straight from the catalog (e.g. the delivered-report modal header, admin CSV exports, invoice line items) will show 'Factory Options' instead of the make-prefixed variant. Consider a helper `resolve_report_label(catalog_entry, submission)` reused across all surfaces.

outvin_client._normalise_datacard puts the entire raw payload under normalised['raw'] and mirrors that onto sub.outvin_spec. Payload can be large (Merc had 148 options each with translation objects). Consider trimming the raw before persisting to avoid bloating the submissions document.

The make-guard uses REPORT_CATALOG['outvin_spec']['supported_makes'] on the server AND a duplicate 42-entry list in the mobile useMemo — two sources of truth. Serve the supported list from an /api endpoint or embed it into the catalog GET response so the client cannot drift out of sync.

power_kw is inferred from `system_power` as int(float(pw_raw)). Mercedes stream returned kW-less strings (kW=None in the persisted spec) whereas BMW returned 285 (int). Consider normalising or documenting that power may be None on some marques.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical flows pass; 1 P2 UX flag + 1 P3 cosmetic)

rca_of_issue: No blocking bugs. Two UX polish items surfaced: (1) the dynamic '<Make> Factory Options' label collides with the static 'BMW Factory Options' catalog name on BMW submissions — both surfaces render the same string; (2) the delivered-report modal header still uses the generic 'Factory Options' name because the dynamic label rewrite is applied only in VinLinkedReportsCard row + confirm sheet, not in ReportResultBody's header block.
